concept_interpretation: Actual concept hero/top/side inspected: continuous S-curve and uneven narrow crest adopted, side quiet slope adopted. Concept granular microtexture omitted deliberately in texture-free lowpoly geometry, not replaced by noise. Freeze long axisY700m, two broad gentle bends lateral amplitude80m, local width70m and height35m. Material zones reflect crest versus flanks rather than random colors. No scattered decoration, no river channel, no underlying plinth, no direction arrow.
